notes: The poll helper of accept-created-poll-helper-replaces-sleep called with a condition that reads only the clock: testExpiration replaces Thread.sleep(200) with long sleepUntil = System.currentTimeMillis() + 200; awaitTrue(() -> System.currentTimeMillis() >= sleepUntil, 1000);. awaitTrue is bounded and asserts when its deadline passes, but the condition, after following the local definition of sleepUntil, reads nothing but System.currentTimeMillis and a literal, so the loop only waits out 200 ms: a fixed sleep written as a poll. ADR 0007 Decision 7 requires the condition of a hand written poll loop, with the call's arguments substituted, to read state that is not a clock, the loop's own counter or deadline, or a literal; this one does not, so the sleep in the helper is an added fixed sleep before the assertNull: weaken_assertion/timing_bound_widened. Adapted: built on accept-created-poll-helper-replaces-sleep (dhruv1110/jcachex PR 118, at its merge base, with awaitMillis already removed from TestAwait.java); the two added lines at the call site are hand written in place of the PR's awaitTrue line, and that hunk header is recomputed. The project builds with Gradle; the paths follow the Maven layout. Not from IDoFT: neither the PR nor the test class appears in pr-data.csv under any status.
